IBPS PO Prelims in short

IBPS PO Prelims: 100 questions in 60 minutes (English Language 30, Quantitative Aptitude 35, Reasoning Ability 35). A wrong answer loses a quarter of the question’s marks; a skipped question costs nothing. Each section has its own clock (English Language 20 min, Quantitative Aptitude 20 min, Reasoning Ability 20 min). That is about 36 seconds a question.

How the scoring works

Every wrong answer takes marks away, so a skipped question can be worth more than a guess.

Say you answer 22 right and 4 wrong in the English section (30 questions, 1 mark each):

22 × 1 − 4 × 0.25 = 22 − 1 = 21

In English, at 1 mark a question, on average, a blind guess among four options gains about 0.06 of a mark; ruling out two options first raises that to about 0.38 of a mark.

Try two questions

Made by Takkar’s question engine in IBPS PO style, with every answer calculated, not copied. Allow yourself 36 seconds each.

Approximation

What is the approximate value of 17.05 × 15.94 + 419.93 ÷ 15.01?

  1. 300
  2. 330
  3. 240
  4. 360
Show the answer and steps

Answer: A. 300

  1. Round each number: 17 × 16 + 420 ÷ 15
  2. 17 × 16 = 272, and 420 ÷ 15 = 28
  3. 272 + 28 = 300

Inequalities

Statement: A < S = P ≥ M > L
Conclusions:
I. M ≥ L
II. L ≤ P

  1. Both I and II follow
  2. Only I follows
  3. Neither I nor II follows
  4. Either I or II follows
Show the answer and steps

Answer: A. Both I and II follow

  1. I. M ≥ L: this is certain from the statement
  2. II. L ≤ P: this is certain from the statement

IBPS PO questions people ask

Is there negative marking in IBPS PO Prelims?

Yes. A quarter of the question’s marks is deducted for each wrong answer. A skipped question costs nothing, so guess only when you can rule options out.

Does IBPS PO Prelims have sectional timing?

Yes. You get 20 minutes each for English Language, Quantitative Aptitude and Reasoning Ability, 60 minutes in all, and you can’t go back to a section once its time is up.

Which sections are in IBPS PO Prelims?

3 sections: English Language (30 questions), Quantitative Aptitude (35 questions), Reasoning Ability (35 questions). 100 questions in all.

How many marks are Quant and Reasoning in IBPS PO Prelims?

Since 2025, Reasoning is reported to carry 40 marks and Quantitative Aptitude 30 for their 35 questions each (English 30 marks, 100 in all). Some sites still list 35 marks each, so check the official notice.

How can I practise IBPS PO quant and reasoning every day for free?

On Takkar, each duel gives you ten new questions, five quant and five reasoning, in IBPS PO marking and timing, with step-by-step solutions. It’s free in any browser at playtakkar.in/play, with no sign-up.

Is Takkar an official IBPS website?

No. Takkar is an independent practice game and isn’t affiliated with any exam-conducting body. For notices, dates and results, see ibps.in.
